# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It obsoletes the last pre-v4 legacy paint/font APIs, reworks the singleton lifecycle, fixes pixel-span stride/offset bugs, and adds variable font, color-font-palette and animated WebP support. This is a breaking release for anyone consuming Vulkan, default typefaces, or long stream seeks — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy pre-v4 paint/font APIs are now compile errors** — The SKPaint text/font members obsoleted since v3 (and the legacy enums trimmed from the ref assembly) are now hard errors instead of warnings. Move typeface, text size, and text measurement onto SKFont/SKFontMetrics. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **new SKFont() and new SKPaint() no longer resolve a lazy default typeface** — Upstream removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs, MeasureText returns 0) instead of resolving to the platform default; new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, and detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are never null** — A missing family now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (previously null on Android), and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere, including Android API 36+. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on overflow** — The native offset is a 32-bit int; Move(long) previously truncated out-of-range offsets silently. It now throws OverflowException for values outside int range and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and aborts the process (not an exception — unrecoverable) if the instance or device is below that version, or if GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion is left at its default 0. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion. Hardware that is genuinely Vulkan 1.0-only can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan at all. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **Vulkan interop structs changed: GRVkBackendContextNative fields removed, GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed** — GRVkBackendContextNative dropped fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice — use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead, and there is no replacement for ownership tracking. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gained a Components field (changing its layout) and lost value-equality; GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Bumped to Skia milestone m148** — Updates the bundled engine to Skia m148 and merges the intervening upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color-font-palette support** — Adds full variable font support (SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp) and color font palette selection, improving variable font robustness overall. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream export** — Adds SKWebpEncoder animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions on surface/canvas draw, plus new HarfBuzz color helper** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain SKSamplingOptions overloads, and HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t interop; several missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes were also added. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel-span stride and offset corrected** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the (x,y) offset overload uses Height instead of Width. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash and default-typeface resolution fixed** — Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer to fix a missing-font crash on newer Android. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Platform build and TFM fixes** — Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9, corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), and fixes SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **New native platform targets** — Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and x64/arm64 Tizen native builds. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates expat, freetype, zlib, libpng, libjpeg-turbo and libexpat to their latest patched versions, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0, adding the HBColor struct for hb_color_t interop, full variable font shaping support, and several API wrapper and naming-convention fixes.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Reworked the singleton lifecycle, promoted the remaining legacy paint/font APIs to compile errors, fixed the GetPixelSpan stride/offset bugs, and bumped to Skia m148 ahead of the stable release.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Added the HBColor struct and further HarfBuzz API wrappers, enabled TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding, and updated HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Added animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData(), fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, and corrected Apple platform TFMs.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Opened the v4 line: bumped Skia to milestone 147, added variable font support and SKSamplingOptions surface/canvas draw overloads, upgraded SkiaSharp's major version from 3.x to 4.x, and refreshed several native dependencies.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
